name: tablebench-instruct
description: tablebench-instruct evaluates models' ability to follow instructions and perform reasoning over tabular data, including table-based question answering, text-to-SQL transformations, and data-to-text generation. It measures how well models interpret table structure, execute logical operations, and produce accurate, instruction-compliant outputs.
reputation: A useful benchmark for table understanding and instruction-following tasks with growing use in evaluations of instruction-tuned LMs and table-specialized systems.
